title: The North Face Mica 12 review: a light freestanding solo tent with room for a tall camper
dek: A two-pole, 9 mm solo tent at 2 lb 12 oz. Its one owner review, from a 6-foot-3 camper, says it fits comfortably.
subject: The North Face Mica 12
verdict: The Mica 12 is a light, freestanding solo tent that pitches easily, even on sand dunes, and its owner review says a 6-foot-3 camper fits comfortably. It has less sitting headroom than some competitors, and there's little storm data, so treat its weather performance as unproven.
bestFor: Solo backpackers, including taller ones, who want a light freestanding tent.
notFor: Anyone needing proven storm performance or lots of sitting headroom.
pros: Fits a 6'3" camper with a small pack inside
cons: Less sitting headroom than some rivals
Little owner data on storm performance
body:
## The short version

The Mica 12 is a freestanding one-person tent with two 9 mm poles and an 18-square-foot floor. Its one owner review on Trailspace is short and positive.

## Space

The reviewer is 6 foot 3 and 215 pounds and fits comfortably, with enough headroom lying down to keep a small pack inside. Sitting-up room is less than in some competing tents, but he found it adequate.

## Setup

He describes it as light and easy to pitch, even on the White Sands dunes, without needing the instructions. Being freestanding, it's easy to move after it's up.

## Weather

The reviewer hadn't been caught in a storm yet, which is why he held back a perfect rating. There's little other owner data, so treat its storm performance as unproven.

## Poles and parts

The Mica 12 uses **2 poles**, **9 mm** tubing.

The North Face doesn't publish pole lengths. To match a replacement, lay your pole out straight, measure tip to tip, count the sections, and read the diameter printed near a joint (or use calipers). Then search the Mica 12 in our [pole and parts finder](/poles?model=Mica%2012), compare against measured stock in the [pole size chart](/poles/sizes), or search by measurement in [find a pole by size](/poles/size).

## Bottom line

For a solo backpacker who wants a light freestanding tent with room for a tall body, a used Mica 12 is worth a look. Check the fly coating and seams like any tent from its era.
